acceptance_gates.G1_pace: validation MAE <= 10.0s (H-comparable absolute gate; decontaminated windows)
acceptance_gates.G2_gap: steady ACTIVE gap-change median <= 1.0s AND p90 <= 3.0s (~2x PRE baseline 0.42/1.53)
acceptance_gates.G3_order: steady ACTIVE change rate <= 15% (PRE baseline bound 14.4%)
acceptance_gates.G6_pit_fail_closed: rule specified: refuse VSC simulation crossing pit events under VSC (no validated loss model)
acceptance_gates.G7_causality: interval semantics causal (C contract); poison-pinned; deterministic
acceptance_gates.G8_green_parity: GREEN path byte-identical (isolation + frozen suites green)

calibration.parameter: R = median driver-lap ACTIVE/PRE ratio, pooled calibration ACTIVE laps
calibration.race_specific_alternative: per-race median ratio (research comparison only; global preferred unless validation proves need)

candidates.V0: refuse VSC (frozen control; explicit TRACK rejection)
candidates.V1: global pace ratio R (median ACTIVE/PRE on calibration episodes) applied to expected green pace during causally-known VSC laps; frozen ordering mechanics
candidates.V2: V1 + validated gap-preservation claim (uniform ratio; no extra mechanism)
candidates.V3: EXCLUDED at protocol time: pit-loss evidence insufficient (out-lap marginals n=7); fail-closed where pit events are relevant

coverage_note: no gate uses coverage percentage; +41/38.57% is context only

duration_gate.on_failure: duration remains the integration blocker (confirms H); no duration component fitted
duration_gate.rule: median-duration predictor; calibration slope in [0.5, 1.5] AND MAE <= 1.0 lap on validation split

exclusions: entry/exit transition laps from ACTIVE pace metric
retirement laps from order metric (retrospective label)

metrics.duration: median-duration rule MAE (laps) + calibration slope on validation split (independent H check)
metrics.gap: steady ACTIVE pairwise-gap-change distribution vs PRE baseline
metrics.order: steady ACTIVE position-change rate vs PRE baseline
metrics.pace: MAE of R_cal*base vs actual ACTIVE lap times (seconds, absolute scale)

rejection_criteria: any of G1-G5 fails on the validation split
duration gate fails => integration blocked (dynamics may still be reported, verdict at most INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE)
seed_policy: deterministic replay only; zero stochastic futures in D; no RNG streams created or consumed

validation.aggregation: episode-macro (each episode equal weight) + pooled driver-lap; both reported
validation.episodes: usable validation split (2022-2024), unscored until this protocol froze
